issues.description: Method mismatch for PersonService.addParent(Person, Person): the Problem Statement and the template repository declare/expect a public method PersonService.addParent(Person person, Person parent) (students must implement and PersonResource calls it). In the solution repository the method is declared private (private Person addParent(Person person, Person parent)). Because PersonResource (in de.tum.in.ase.eist.rest.PersonResource) invokes personService.addParent(...), the private visibility in the solution prevents external callers from accessing the method and would cause a compilation/access error or inconsistent behavior compared to the template and problem specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make PersonService.addParent(Person person, Person parent) public in the solution repository to match the template and the problem statement (change signature to: public Person addParent(Person person, Person parent)). Ensure the method signature remains unchanged so PersonResource can call it. Alternatively, if the intent is to keep it non-public, expose an equivalent public API that PersonResource uses and update callers accordingly, but the simplest fix is to restore public visibility to match the exercise specification.
